historical_file_nodes.name: bar_cache.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: Thread-safe bounded BarCache holding the latest OHLCV bars per (symbol, timeframe) from the NT8 TCP feed; bars_historical frames merge-seed (preserving reconnect chart depth) and bar_update frames upsert, read by the kernel decision feed and the chart relay.
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Copy-on-read snapshots under sync.RWMutex keep kernel/chart reads from blocking the socket drain goroutine; 2500-bar ring per key covers the 2000-bar re-seed window.

historical_file_nodes.name: csv_tailer.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: Legacy CSV-bridge fill tailer that polls trades_taken.csv and delivers newly appended fill rows to a callback, tracking the read offset across polls.

historical_file_nodes.name: csv_writer.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: Legacy CSV-bridge signal writer producing the 5-field trade_signals.csv row atomically (temp file plus retried rename) for the vltrader.cs AddOn to consume.
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Atomic temp-file + rename write with the rename retried via internal/retry to survive transient Windows file locks seen through WSL.

historical_file_nodes.name: mock_nt.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: Mock NinjaTrader harness for the CSV bridge: a background goroutine polls trade_signals.csv, dedups signals by DateTime+Direction+EntryPrice, and writes synthetic fills to trades_taken.csv — for tests and nq_smoke only, never production.

historical_file_nodes.name: tcp_client_mock.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: In-process mock TCP client emulating the C# AddOn's wire behaviour: dials the Go TCPServer, acks signals and heartbeats, and emits fill frames after a configurable delay; drives tcp_server tests and the nq_smoke tcp sub-command.

historical_file_nodes.name: tcp_framing.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: TCP wire codec for the NT8 bridge: 4-byte big-endian length-prefixed JSON envelopes with WriteFrame/ReadFrame plus the full set of payload structs (signals, fills, bars, accounts, positions, feed status) shared with the C# AddOn.
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Length-prefixed JSON framing with a 1 MB cap; the exported payload structs double as the wire schema contract with the C# AddOn.

historical_file_nodes.name: types.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: Defines the 5-field SignalRow and 3-field FillRow CSV records exchanged with NT8’s vltrader.cs strategy, with SignalRow validation of direction and stop-loss/take-profit price ordering.

historical_file_nodes.name: tcp_server.go
historical_file_nodes.summary: Go-side endpoint of the NT8 TCP bridge: single-client listener on 127.0.0.1:36974 with a pending-signal queue (stale-drop on reconnect), 30s heartbeats, per-symbol bar subscriptions feeding the BarCache, multi-account state, and per-symbol fan-out routers for fills, closes, rejects, and instrument info.
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Heavy goroutine architecture: accept loop, per-connection read loop (a 340-line frame dispatcher), heartbeat loop, and a buffered bar-ingest drain channel; sync.Once-guarded routers fan frames out to per-symbol subscriber channels.

historical_file_nodes.name: VLBarsSubscriptionManager.cs
historical_file_nodes.summary: C# side of the NT8 bar feed: owns one BarsRequest per symbol/timeframe, streams bars_historical and bar_update frames to the Go bot through VLTraderTCPClient's writeLock-serialized SendFrame, and self-heals feed gaps via reconnect rebuilds plus a two-tier stall watchdog (20s fast guard, 75-min backstop).
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Dependencies are injected as delegates (sendFrame/logInfo/logWarn) instead of a parent back-reference, keeping the class off the parent's network state; handles NT8 quirks like local-time bars, multi-bar .Update ranges, and BarsRequests that silently die after feed drops.

historical_file_nodes.name: VLContractResolver.cs
historical_file_nodes.summary: Shared static resolver mapping Go-side symbols (bare roots like MNQ or Databento continuous forms like NQ.c.0) to NT8 qualified front-month instrument names ("MNQ 06-26") using quarterly third-Friday expiries with an 8-day pre-roll, keeping the bars and signal paths in lockstep.
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately pure C# — no Newtonsoft, LINQ, or NT8 API — so it can be unit-tested outside NinjaTrader; only quarterly-cycle CME roots are whitelisted, energy/metals pass through unresolved rather than mis-rolling.

historical_file_nodes.name: VLTraderTCPClient.cs
historical_file_nodes.summary: NinjaScript AddOn implementing the NT8-side TCP bridge: connects to the Go bot at 127.0.0.1:36974, exchanges length-prefixed JSON frames (protocol v2), executes AI signals as entry orders with fill-triggered SL/TP brackets on per-account routing, and streams fills, position closes, accounts, balances, feed status, and heartbeats back to Go.
historical_file_nodes.languageNotes: Uses a hand-rolled JSON encoder/parser (no Newtonsoft) with all socket writes serialized through a single writeLock; dedicated reader and heartbeat threads with CancellationTokenSource; BarsRequest rebuilds on reconnect are debounced 30s so a flapping feed coalesces into one deep (2000-bar) refetch.
